content.comment_body: Hello, I was working with a [product_name] ([article_no]) model. My application involves three analog inputs. I am able to detect values from two analog inputs (AI1, AI2), but the other two inputs (AI3, AI4) are not detected.

Welcome to the forum. You haven't specified which [product_name] model or software version you're using, so I'll explain the process for [product_name] software version [version_no]. In the file properties, you can set how many analog inputs are enabled on the base module—typically, only two (AI1 and AI2) are enabled by default. To use four analog inputs, you need to adjust the settings: File > Properties > Offline Settings > I/O Settings, and set the number of enabled analog inputs to four. After saving your changes, transfer the updated diagram to the [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The main concern is that when using an analog module from the [product_name] product family, only the first two analog inputs are detected by default, while the others remain inactive. Other users highlight that input detection for AI3 and AI4 must be manually enabled in the software settings, indicating that product configuration for additional channels may lack clear guidance or visibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all four analog input channels to be detected and function correctly without needing to perform extra or less obvious configuration steps.
